mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk, and amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risks that may be potentiated in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess for signs of infection, ototoxicity, and nephrotoxicity; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustments based on renal clearance.
